name: accretion-ui-mitosis
description: Single-source Accordion component library authored with Mitosis and published for React and Angular.

scripts.clean: rimraf .generated coverage playwright-report test-results packages/*/dist chromatic/*/storybook-static smoke-apps/react-next/.next smoke-apps/angular-ssr/dist
scripts.generate: npm run generate:styles && npm run generate:components
scripts.build:react: npm run generate && npm run --workspace @accretion-ui/react build
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run --workspace @accretion-ui/react build && node scripts/build-angular-package.mjs
scripts.storybook:react: npm run generate && npm run --workspace @accretion-ui/chromatic-react storybook
scripts.storybook:angular: npm run generate && npm run --workspace @accretion-ui/chromatic-angular storybook
scripts.chromatic:react: npm run generate && node scripts/run-chromatic.mjs react
scripts.chromatic:angular: npm run generate && node scripts/run-chromatic.mjs angular
scripts.test:unit: npm run generate && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && ng test angular-ssr --watch=false
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:playwright
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:react && npm run smoke:angular
scripts.validate:ssr: npm run validate:ssr:react && npm run validate:ssr:angular
scripts.dev:react-ssr: npm run generate && npm run --workspace @accretion-ui/react-smoke dev
scripts.dev:angular-ssr: npm run generate && ng serve angular-ssr
